Add objects the store already holds to the index without a full rebuild

```sh
goback [global flags] index <command>
```

## index commits

Index the commits listed in a file, one hex ref per line

Commits are indexed by set, in the order the store received them. Commits that name no set go under a placeholder set. Nothing is indexed if any ref is not a commit, is tombstoned or is already indexed.

```sh
goback [global flags] index commits [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--refs-file value` | file of commit refs, one hex ref per line |  |  |
| `--dry-run` | report what would be indexed without writing anything |  |  |
